name: HUMIDITY CHAMBER
desc: Premium Double-Walled Laboratory Humidity Chamber engineered for highly precise environmental simulation, climate testing, and stability studies. Features a 100-liter capacity with high-grade Stainless Steel 304 interior and a CFC-free hermetically sealed cooling system.
features: Fully adjustable Temperature Range from +10°C to 70°C
Wide Humidity Control Range from 10% RH to 95% RH
Automated Steam Injection Method for rapid ambient mist creation
Advanced Microprocessor-Based PID Digital Controller Layout
Hermetically sealed CFC-Free compressor unit (R134a eco-refrigerant)

specifications.Interior Dimensions (W x D x H): 450 mm x 400 mm x 500 mm (Tolerance compliant)
specifications.Exterior Dimensions (W x D x H): 600 mm x 1100 mm x 1050 mm industrial footprint
specifications.Exterior Body Material: Heavy-Duty Mild Steel (MS) with durable powder-coated finish
specifications.Refrigeration & Cooling: Hermetically sealed CFC-Free compressor unit (R134a eco-refrigerant)
specifications.Humidity Generation System: Automated Steam Injection Method for rapid ambient mist creation
specifications.Internal Air Circulation: Quiet running motorized blower system ensuring cross-chamber uniformity
specifications.Humidity Control Range: Wide range operation from 10% RH to 95% RH
specifications.Controller Architecture: Advanced Microprocessor-Based PID Digital Controller Layout
specifications.Trays / Storage Shelves: 3 Removable perforated wire-mesh trays made of strong Stainless Steel
specifications.Shelves Load Separation: Adjustable setup maintaining a standard 15 cm distance between trays
specifications.Chamber Lighting & Safeties: Fluorescent light with automated door switch and CE compliant wiring
specifications.Integrated Safety Systems: High-temperature safety cutoff mechanism for absolute system protection
specifications.Target Field Applications: Plant Growth, Insect Culture, Cosmetics Testing, and Packaging Stability
specifications.Warranty & Quality Compliance: 1 Year Comprehensive Manufacturer Warranty with CE Certification
